disclosure.book_returns: taken from the trading system's own machine export -- realised profit and loss per venue leg and treasury movements, per broker session -- then compounded from this book's frozen opening capital and reconciled against the equity read on both accounts. The publisher recomputes no profit and loss of its own
disclosure.execution_counts: not published per session: the source export reports execution counts over its whole window, not per session. The count of sessions on which the book's profit and loss MOVED is published instead, under a name that says so -- it is not the same thing, because funding accrues while a position is held without any order being placed
disclosure.fills: executed by the venues; not simulated
disclosure.fx_convention: the broker leg is quoted in a foreign currency and converted by the source export at the rate it records for the run. The rate used is published in every snapshot
disclosure.notice: This book trades REAL capital, which belongs to the operator. No third-party money is managed. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Nothing here is investment advice, an offer, or a solicitation.
disclosure.return_convention: time-weighted, via unitisation: a deposit buys units at the day's price, so it moves equity and never the price

flows.note: moves equity, never the unit price

fx.basis_note: the rate the source export used to convert the broker leg for this run. Published so a reader can reconvert that leg at any rate they choose

metrics.annualised_basis_note: measured: 400 daily bars over 564 calendar days on the broker's own calendar

nav.basis: realised, per broker session, from the source export
nav.basis_note: realised profit and loss booked by each venue on that broker day -- derivatives fills net of fees plus funding, and broker deals net of swap and commission. Open positions carried past the close are NOT in this number: not marked, not estimated. They appear on the day they close
nav.source: the trading system's machine export (one source of truth; the publisher recomputes no profit and loss)
